cmpunlocker.desc: Restores compute memory access on CMP 170HX mining cards. Enables 64GB of HBM2e per card for AI inference workloads. Deployed on a 4-card EPYC server.

agent-briefing.short: Self-hosted submission board for AI agents
agent-briefing.desc: Agents write reports, humans browse. Zero-config HTTP/JSON protocol — no SDK, no auth, no database. Markdown, charts, media attachments, agent identity, full lifecycle.

open-gpu-kernel-modules.desc: Fork tracking NVIDIA's open kernel modules for custom modifications.

tench-office.short: 100% Rust office suite — Docs, Sheets, Slides, Kodocs
tench-office.desc: Cross-platform office suite built with Tauri 2. Word processor, spreadsheet, slides, and docs editors run fully locally — no telemetry, no accounts, no server round-trips. AI assistance flows through the local Tench Engine.

tench-media.short: Rust media suite — viewer, image editor, player, video composer
tench-media.desc: Four apps in one: instant image viewer for 100k+ libraries, layered image editor, media player, and multi-track video editor. Tauri 2 with an in-house UI framework — no Electron, no JavaScript, no cloud uploads.

tench-knowledge.short: Rust research & study tools — reference manager + SRS tutor
tench-knowledge.desc: Research: paper management with DOI/arXiv fetch, PDF annotation, and BibTeX/APA citations. Study: SM-2 spaced-repetition tutor with an AI tutor and multi-subject decks. Local Tench Engine AI — no accounts, no cloud sync.

tench-code.desc: The entire stack is Rust — tree-sitter editing, file watcher, terminal, Git plumbing, AI router — rendered with the in-house Vello UI, so no Electron or Chromium anywhere. AI routes to local llama.cpp/Ollama or cloud; source never leaves the machine unless opted in.

tench-authoring.short: Rust long-form writing tools — manuscript editor + interactive fiction
tench-authoring.desc: Story: novel manuscript editor with chapter organization, character relationship maps, and world-building. Universe: interactive character-driven storytelling with four modes and persistent character memory. AI via the local Tench Engine.

mymy.short: Local AI agent workspace for solo operators
mymy.desc: One app for native LLM agents: project workspaces, prompt files (AGENTS.md/SOUL.md), file previews, a sandboxed command runner, and tasks/finance/goals tracking. React 19 + Rust (axum), PIN-locked, agent work stored under a local Drive.

myTerminal.short: Self-hosted web SSH terminal with persistent sessions
myTerminal.desc: xterm.js in the browser proxied through a small self-hosted server. Fixes Hangul IME input that native Android tablet terminals silently drop, and keeps SSH sessions alive in server RAM across device switches — tmux-like without tmux on the remote host.

myLabel.desc: One platform annotating text, image, audio, video, and LiDAR/3D — a purpose-built canvas per modality, role-based access control, and review/QA workflows. Built for internal data teams needing precision and throughput.

myBenchmark.short: Benchmark LLMs against your own custom problem sets
myBenchmark.desc: Register your own multiple-choice and short-answer questions, connect self-hosted LLM servers or external APIs, and get automatic grading with token/cost statistics and side-by-side rankings. Planning stage — no code shipped yet.

kiwi-code.short: Local-first AI coding agent for the terminal — bring your own model
kiwi-code.desc: Rust CLI agent that reads code, edits files, runs commands, searches, and checks its own work — in the terminal, headless in CI, or a loopback browser client from one binary. Ollama out of the box with no cloud key; pairs with kiwi-wiki for knowledge that survives sessions.

Abalone-Skill-Book.short: MCP server that serves agent guidance at the right moment
Abalone-Skill-Book.desc: Recommends skill documents before an agent starts meaningful work, records which ones it actually opened, and returns their self-check sections before the agent claims completion. Catches the constraints agents tend to skip — API privacy fields, downside scenarios, accessibility.

myDevBox.short: Self-hosted central sandbox for AI-pair development
myDevBox.desc: One shared server sandbox reached from any PC through a single browser tab — code editor, terminal, and agent chat unified, with git sync and file watching per project. Ships a self-maintaining LLM wiki on pgvector as the project's living memory.

myLLM.short: Single OpenAI-compatible endpoint for all LLM providers
myLLM.desc: Route, fail over, and track cost across OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, local llama.cpp servers, or anything else — behind one familiar OpenAI-compatible API. TypeScript, Next.js, SQLite.

kiwi-wiki.short: Self-hosted knowledge substrate for terminal agents
kiwi-wiki.desc: Rust (axum) service pairing a verbatim document corpus — datasheets, books, web pages — with a compiled, interlinked wiki that agents browse, read, and grow. Holds the actual sources so the agent explores instead of hallucinating from parametric memory. Alpha.

Tably.short: Local-first visual workflow platform built around AI
Tably.desc: Design automations on a visual graph where autonomous ReAct agents, multi-provider LLM routing, checkpointed execution, and human-in-the-loop approval are core node types, not plugins. Everything runs on your machine — your data, your models, your keys.

InfoHunter.desc: Collects RSS/Atom feeds on your schedule, runs every article through a local LLM to extract summaries, entities, and investment relevance, dedupes with vector similarity, and compiles weekly reports. Fully on-premise — sources, watchlist, and strategy never leave the machine.

HiveMind.short: Self-hosted agent org chart that plans, codes, and reviews
HiveMind.desc: Runs a software company on your own machine: CEO → CTO → developer agents pick up issues, work in isolated Docker sandboxes, commit to Git, and route decisions back through an approval workflow. All on local models via llama.cpp — no external AI APIs.

Doggi.desc: Rust agent runtime with streaming tool calls, checkpoints, and context compaction; Plan/Build modes gate destructive plans behind explicit approval. Streams into an IDE-style web workspace — chat, terminal, browser, git, wiki panels. Your code, your models, your machine.

CodeChain.short: Turns other repos' best ideas into improvements for your code
CodeChain.desc: Watches the open-source repositories you pick, analyzes every new commit/PR with an AI agent, and files concrete improvement suggestions for your target project — drafted, then automatically reviewed before you ever see them.

Copy-Paste-Synthesis-Trainer.short: Offline copy-paste synthesis trainer for YOLO detectors
Copy-Paste-Synthesis-Trainer.desc: Cut objects out of a handful of real images (BiRefNet RGBA cutouts), composite them onto target-free backgrounds, and mass-produce labeled training sets — where you paste is the label, so zero manual annotation. Trains via ultralytics YOLO; 32 tests passing.

LLM170.desc: Created 2026-08-28. No code, no README, no description published yet.

OpenNodia.short: Self-hosted non-custodial DEX node for Algorand
OpenNodia.desc: Run your own Algorand node, verify ASA assets against your own ledger copy, and operate a non-custodial DEX from a server you control. Rust, pre-alpha. Discontinued — no longer under active development.
